svg.title: The budget takes from linked threads first
svg.desc: A worked example with a budget of 3,000 tokens. Left: three threads in the store with the length of each post in tokens: #812, the one the agent works on, 2,100 tokens in five posts; a linked issue #790, 1,570 in four; a linked pull request #801, 1,120 in three. Right: the context keeps all 2,100 tokens of #812. Status lines take 150, which leaves 750 for the linked threads. Newest posts are taken first: 250 and 300 from #790 and 190 from #801 fit, and the four older posts are left out.
svg.text: One bar per post, with its length in tokens.
#812, the thread the agent works on
A budget of 3,000 tokens, the default.
#812, the thread the agent works on
3,000, less 150 for the status lines and 2,100 for #812, leaves 750 for the linked threads. Newest posts are taken first, and one that does not fit is passed over: 250, 190 and
300 fit, the next ones do not.
Posts of the agent's own thread are shortened only past three times the budget, 9,000 tokens at the default.
